items.source: NOTE: If this method returns true, any parameters that might have been set during the last setValues call will be ignored! Make sure that you set a corresponding internal flag if you detect exhaustion at the beginning of your setValues implementation, letting this method return true based on the flag.
items.translation: 注意：如果此方法返回 true，则任何在最后一次 setValues 调用期间可能设置的参数将被忽略！如果您检测到耗尽情况，请确保在您的 setValues 实现的开头设置相应的内部标志，使此方法基于该标志返回 true。

items.source: The isBatchExhausted(int) method is called after each call to BatchPreparedStatementSetter.setValues(PreparedStatement, int) to determine whether there were some values added, or if the batch was determined to be complete and no additional values were provided during the last call to setValues.
items.translation: `isBatchExhausted(int)` 方法在每次调用 `BatchPreparedStatementSetter.setValues(PreparedStatement, int)` 之后被调用，以确定是否添加了一些值，或者该批次是否已确定完成，并且在最后一次调用 `setValues` 期间未提供额外的值。

items.source: Consider extending the AbstractInterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter base class instead of implementing this interface directly, using a single setValuesIfAvailable callback method that checks for available values and sets them, returning whether values have actually been provided.
items.translation: 考虑扩展 AbstractInterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter 基类，而不是直接实现此接口，使用单个 setValuesIfAvailable 回调方法来检查可用值并设置它们，返回是否实际提供了值。

items.source:
This interface allows you to signal the end of a batch rather than
having to determine the exact batch size upfront. Batch size is still
being honored, but it is now the maximum size of the batch.
items.translation: 该接口允许您标记批处理结束，而无需预先确定确切的批处理大小。批处理大小仍然有效，但现在它代表的是批处理的最大大小。

items.source: whether the batch is already exhausted
Return whether the batch is complete, that is, whether there were no additional values added during the last setValues call.
items.translation: 返回该批次是否完整，即在上次调用setValues期间是否没有添加额外的值。

items.source: i - index of the statement we're issuing in the batch, starting from 0
items.translation: - 我们在批处理中发出的语句的索引，从 0 开始
